snippet.title: YOMOTSU Trailer
snippet.description:
A transport that sets out at dusk and arrives at midnight. A world above. A world below. YOMOTSU is the thin line that connects the two. You are but another unfortunate soul that happened to be at the wrong place at the wrong time. Enjoy your ride.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/846020/YOMOTSU/
Itch.io: https://akumugames.itch.io/yomotsu

Video editing by: White Charisma
